title: Slow-cooker chicken noodle soup
subtitle: Classic comforting broth with chicken, vegetables, and egg noodles
excerpt: Chicken, carrot, celery, onion, and egg noodles in a clear golden broth. One of the best things a slow cooker can make. Simple and deeply satisfying.
sourceNotes: Chicken noodle soup is one of the most widely made soups in home cooking across Britain, North America, and Eastern Europe. The slow-cooker method extracts maximum flavour from the chicken over a long, gentle cook.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: Make the broth and chicken a day ahead and refrigerate. Add freshly cooked noodles when reheating.

content.text: This soup is best with chicken thighs rather than breast. The thighs stay moist and release more flavour into the broth. The key is to add the noodles only in the last 30 minutes; any longer and they will become soft and break apart.

The broth is the point here. Use a good-quality chicken stock and do not rush the cook time. After 6 hours, the vegetables will be very soft and the broth will have deepened in flavour. Taste and season carefully before serving.
Serve with crusty bread or buttered toast. A few drops of hot sauce in the bowl are good.

Place {{chicken-thighs-boneless}} of chicken thighs in the slow cooker. Add {{carrot}} of sliced carrot, {{celery}} of sliced celery, {{onion}} diced onion, and {{garlic}} of crushed garlic. Tuck in {{thyme}} of thyme sprigs and {{bay-leaves}} of bay. Pour over {{stock-chicken}} of chicken stock. Season with {{sea-salt-fine}} of salt and {{black-pepper-ground}} of black pepper.

Set the slow cooker to LOW and cook for 5 to 6 hours. The chicken should be very tender. Lift the chicken out and shred it with two forks. Return the shredded meat to the pot. Discard the thyme sprigs and bay leaves. Taste and adjust the seasoning.
Switch the slow cooker to HIGH. Add {{noodles-egg}} of egg noodles and push them under the broth. Cook for 20 to 30 minutes until the noodles are just tender. Serve straight away.

rows.cause: Egg noodles cook quickly and become very soft if left too long in a hot slow cooker.
rows.fix: Check at 20 minutes rather than 30. Next time, cook the noodles separately in boiling water and add them directly to the bowls at serving.

rows.symptom: The broth is very pale and lacks flavour
rows.cause: The stock was diluted or was low quality.
rows.fix: Add a stock cube or tablespoon of concentrated stock. Simmer with the lid off on HIGH for 15 minutes to reduce and intensify the broth.

rows.cause: After 6 hours, most vegetables will be very well cooked and will have lost their structure.
rows.fix: This is intentional for this style of soup. For firmer vegetables, add carrots and celery in the last 2 hours only.

rows.cause: Good-quality stock is already seasoned. Adding salt on top of seasoned stock can make the soup too salty.
rows.fix: Add a diced raw potato and let it cook in the soup for 20 minutes; it will absorb some of the salt. Next time, taste the stock before seasoning.

content.text: Chicken noodle soup appears in the domestic repertoire of almost every culture that uses chicken. In Britain it is associated with comfort and recovery. In Jewish cooking it is known as golden soup and is a Sabbath staple. The slow-cooker method is the easiest way to get deep flavour without tending a pot on the hob.
